mintAuthority.summary: JPYC v1 is a non-upgradeable legacy ERC-20 ('JPYC is ERC20, owned') with an owner-restricted mint(address,uint256) function; JPYC Inc. as contract owner is the sole minter against yen reserves.

controls.label: JPYC v1 Ethereum owner/minter (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295183: eth_getStorageAt slot 5 of 0x2370f9d504c7a6e775bf6e14b3f12846b594cd53 returned 0x94c2d94a786e1aaa07e95d084e88cd3a0680d152; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). EIP-1967 impl slot is zero (non-upgradeable).

controls.label: JPYC v1 Polygon (UChildERC20Proxy / PoS bridge)
controls.evidence: Blockscout confirms Polygon JPYC v1 (0x6ae7dfc7...) is a UChildERC20Proxy controlled by the Polygon PoS bridge predicate, not JPYC Inc. directly.

controls.label: JPYC v1 Gnosis (OmniBridge EternalStorageProxy)
controls.evidence: At Gnosis block 25295183: storage slots 6–7 of 0x417602f4fbdd471a431ae29fb5fe0a681964c11b returned 0xf6a78083ca3e2a662d6dd1703c939c8ace2e268d (EternalStorageProxy = Gnosis OmniBridge); mint on Gnosis is bridge-mediated.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295183: storage slot 5 returned EOA 0x94c2d94a786e1aaa07e95d084e88cd3a0680d152 as owner/minter; contract is non-upgradeable. Polygon deployment is UChildERC20Proxy (Polygon PoS bridge). Gnosis deployment is OmniBridge-controlled (EternalStorageProxy 0xf6a780...). Ethereum direct-minter EOA is JPYC Inc.'s issuer key.
